hook_line: ARK BUYS $96 MILLION OF SPACEX, ADDS NVIDIA AND AMD, TRIMS BROADCOM

hook_stat.sub: SpaceX stock Ark bought across ARKK, ARKQ and ARKW last week, its largest purchase

stats.label: Broadcom sold by Ark, its largest sale last week
Nvidia added by Ark as it bought the chip sell-off

diaspora_bullets: Ark recorded $346.2 million in gross purchases and $305.8 million in gross sales last week
SpaceX was already ARKK's largest holding at $410.80 million, or 7.28% of the fund, as of November 5
news_summary: Cathie Wood's Ark Invest bought $96.0 million of SpaceX stock across ARKK, ARKQ and ARKW last week, its largest purchase, while selling $122.2 million of Broadcom, its largest sale, and adding $45.9 million of Nvidia and $20.0 million of AMD.
payoff: Ark bought into a sharp semiconductor sell-off in which Nvidia fell about 9% and AMD about 17% on November 5.
